name: ffmpeg-skill
description: Local FFmpeg video/audio editing for coding agents: 42 tools with a machine-readable contract and MCP server, capability detection, probe-first / verify-last workflow. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Local FFmpeg video and audio editing for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: ffmpeg-skill gives coding agents a local video editor: 42 typed FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract, probe-first / verify-last workflow, capability detection, captions and karaoke, reframe, silence removal, loudness, HDR to SDR, and platform delivery checks. No cloud and no API keys — footage stays on the machine. The agent skill lives under skills/; the MCP server (mcp/server.py) is for clients without a shell and is not started by this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Probe this clip, then reframe it to 9:16 with a centre crop and check the result.
Remove silence quieter than -35 dB from this recording and verify the new duration.
Normalise loudness to -14 LUFS / -1 dB TP and export for YouTube.
